text:
Tess: Heads-up  my grandma is popping by at 3:30pm with a small folding bike box (she's bringing the kid's bike). Also a tiny gift box of handmade chocolates - fragile. Can someone pre-print a temp badge and confirm a low locker or corner to stash the bike box? 
Front Desk: Noted Tess! We can print a badge and put the chocolates in a locker. Bike box might be better leaned in the bike room unless you'd rather keep it near the lobby. 
Tess: Bike room is fine but she'll need a seat nearby while she folds/unfolds. Can we reserve the bench by the planter? Also please mark the chocolates "FRAGILE". 
Facilities: Bench by planter is free at 3:30. We can put a small mat down so the box doesn't scuff. Bike room has space in rack area B2 for folded boxes. 
Rafael: If it's a heavy box I can help move it at 3:20. I'm near the elevators. 
Tess: Amazing thanks Rafael! @Front Desk please use a low locker (easy reach) for the chocolate box. 
PackageBot: Note: small gift logged on arrival: 1x "Olive & Oak Chocolates" for Tess. Courier: Neighborhood Express. Status: with front desk pending storage. 
Front Desk: Badge queued (black lanyard): "Tess - Visitor". We'll label chocolate box FRAGILE and place it in locker #6 (low). Bench reserved with mat + sticky note "Reserved 3:25-3:50 - Tess' guest". 
Jun: Quick heads-up the bench cushion has a coffee stain  I have a cover I can toss over it. 
Molly: I can meet at 3:15 to help with folding/unfolding the bike if needed. 
Tess: You are all legends  yes please cover the cushion Jun and thanks Molly. Tiny poll: should we leave the bench reserved? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: free it 
Rafael: :thumbsup: keep, quick visit. 
Front Desk: Package stored in locker #6 labeled "FRAGILE - chocolates". Badge printed and left at desk, photo DM sent to Tess. We'll hold locker contents until 5pm then move to lost & found. 
Tess: Perfect  DM received. Huge thanks everyone, grandma will be very grateful. :heart:
